evidence.title: Build World Models for Interactive Simulation with NVIDIA Cosmos
evidence.excerpt: Simulation / Modeling / Design English 中文 Build World Models for Interactive Simulation with NVIDIA Cosmos Nov 02, 2026 By Pranjali Joshi , Aditya Mahajan , Wonsik Han , Saeed Babamohamadi , Mateusz Sieniawski and Mostafa Toloui Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Cosmos provides world foundation models and development tools for physical AI, addressing sensor adaptation and reliable deployment challenges. Cosmos Framework offers modular, open tools for training, reinforcement learning, optimization, and inference across models including Cosmos 3, NVIDIA Alpamayo, GR00T, Qwen, and pi0.5. Cosmos 3 Nano simulation recipes generate synchronized camera video and LiDAR observations for autonomous vehicle, robotics, and surgical scenarios using released checkpoints. Cosmos NIM microservices deliver accelerated inference with quantization, speculative decoding, and KV-cache-aware routing, achieving roughly 2–3x speedups on H200 GPUs. GPU memory requirements vary by model and task, with Cosmos3-Nano generation needing 58 GiB in BF16 and 44 GiB in FP8 with offloading.
